notes: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR3: 'A SUM clause can appear only in the description of a control footing report group.' ScreenReportEntryClausePresence carries the group's TYPE from its level-01 entry (WrittenGroupKind) to every subordinate entry and, below dialect 2002, refuses a SUM entry in any other group with COBOL6763; from 2002 the arm is off, as §2023:13.18.54.3 SR4 f) admits detail, page and report footing SUM groups. The witness refuses SUM in a DETAIL. Probes (std 85): b) SUM in REPORT HEADING, PAGE HEADING, CONTROL HEADING FINAL, CONTROL HEADING W-K, DETAIL, DE (abbreviated), PAGE FOOTING and REPORT FOOTING each refused with COBOL6763, and a SUM entry at level 10 under a level-05 LINE entry of a DETAIL refused with COBOL6763; d) CONTROL FOOTING FINAL, CONTROL FOOTING W-K and the abbreviated CF W-K accepted, ran and printed 00010 for two 5s; c) the same PAGE HEADING SUM program at --std 2023 accepted (DONE); a, e, f: not reachable by a placement rule (no operand, no file statement).

next.reason: 1985: "A SUM clause can appear only in the description of a control footing report group."; 2023: "The current report group may be a detail and data-name-1 may be defined in a different detail. The current report group may be a report footing". 1985 limits SUM to control footings. 2023 also permits SUM in detail, report footing and page footing groups, and SR8 says 'If the current report group is a control footing', so the restriction is relaxed.
